attention_capture.method: Native pinned-build prefill-only Q and kq_soft_max capture; flash attention disabled in capture tool; exact fully rendered C8 prompt; no generation; side bank attached in process.

observed: All 16 coordinates with an attached bank loaded the expected native bank fingerprint.
Visible rules yielded 8/8 correct answer/path results.
Latent bank conditions yielded 0/24 correct; sparse moderate outputs stopped normally 8/8, while broad settings often terminated at the 2048-token request cap and included repetitive/degraded output.
Direct query capture shows nonzero bank attention on every selected sparse site, and substantial mean final-query mass in broad conditions.
inference: The current failure is not explained by an absent/wrong attached bank or zero attention access. The tested Gemma host numerically attends to the bank but does not reliably interpret the detached KV content as actionable rule memory. Broad injection can dominate attention and destabilize output.
limitations: C8 is a diagnostic calibration over four simple fixtures, not scored Test A/B/C.
Query-capture binary disables flash attention and captures prefill only; it proves the bank contributes attention on the exact prompt but does not independently prove later decode-step usage.
Request-level 2048 token cap remains; broad conditions have length stops.
